title: SimpleEnderButt
description: A simple and customizable Minecraft lobby plugin that lets players launch themselves through the air using an EnderButt item.
body: **SimpleEnderButt** is a fun lobby plugin that gives players an EnderButt item that, when used, launches them into the air. Fully configurable and perfect for lobby servers. ## Features - Customizable item name and lore - Assignable inventory slot - Configurable power levels - Inventory move prevention (if activated) - Sound feedback when the item is used ## Upcoming features: - Customizable cooldown - The option to launch yourself using a command - The option to ride the EnderButt instead of it just launching you If you have a feature idea, please open a GitHub issue [here](https://github.com/VulpineFriend87/SimpleEnderButt/issues) and suggest the new feature, I will be happy to implement it in the next version! ## Support & Documentation For more details, view the source code or open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/VulpineFriend87/SimpleEnderButt). By Vulpine
